lines.en: My cap bobs with each step.
I walk over fallen leaves.
My stalk serves as a leg.
Spores drift along behind me.
I wander the dark forest.
A mushroom person takes a stride.
Little caps sprout where I tread.
Damp earth steadies my steps.
My gills open and close as I move.
I skirt around a dead trunk.
The forest smells so strong.
I shuffle over, one step at a time.
I stand in the tree shadows.
My cap keeps the rain off.
I am waiting for night.
Spores settle slowly around me.
Is anyone passing by?
I breathe in the rotting leaves.
Do not mistake me for dinner.
Poison has no hold on me.
I count the mushrooms on the trunk.
Mycelium creeps beneath the ground.
I am as quiet as a tree.
The dark forest is loud with insects.
I am growing a little taller.
The sound of an axe makes me shiver.
I let out a slow breath.
It itches under my cap.
Are you here for mushrooms?
Put that axe away.
Do I look edible to you?
You smell of fire.
Stay off my mushroom bed.
Your fingers are moving.
You crushed one of my kin.
You came into the woods alone.
I do not like that look.
What are you looking for?
This patch is mine.
Stand still and do not move.
I count your weapons.
There is something behind you.
My cap is cracking.
Spores scatter everywhere.
You hit my stalk.
I smell my own sap.
It hurts, it hurts.
I take a step back.
My gills are quivering.
That was enough.
I will not fall so easily.
My stalk will not hold much longer.
The smell of rotting wood is lovely.
That rotting log is mine.
I smell wet earth.
Are you feeding me?
My mycelium reaches that way.
A shaded spot is best.
There is an old stump over there.
I want to root there.
Do not take that rotting leaf.
I want a taste of that soil.
Do not bump my cap.
I stand quite steady.
You knocked loose a cloud of spores.
Back off, I smell strong.
My stalk is not soft.
You stepped on my mycelium.
Do not push, I can walk.
I wobbled a little.
You are covered in spores now.
Bump me and you will feel dizzy.
My spores must fly far.
Two caps lean together.
Our mycelium meets underground.
A new bed will grow.
The wind is up, perfect.
I scatter my spores.
The forest will have more of me.
Do not stand here just now.
We look exactly alike.
Spores settle into the rotting leaves.
I curl a hypha around it.
I will keep what you drop.
A red mushroom, my ration.
I can swallow an iron nugget too.
There is room under my cap.
I will take this wood.
I press it into the mushroom bed.
My fingers are sticky.
Picked up means not returned.
One pull of hypha and it is gone.
You disturbed my mushroom bed.
I smell the heat of you.
The spores are counting for you.
You are prey now.
You will not leave the dark forest.
My hand is raised.
You smell of axe.
Stand still.
The spores are counting for you.
From now on, you are the target.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，蘑菇撑起一个人影。
lines.en: In the dark forest, a mushroom props up a figure.
The eyes under my cap light up.
Hiding behind that tree will not help.
I close in on you slowly.
Spores drift all around you.
Your breathing sped up.
Keep backing up and you reach the swamp.
I raise my hand and gather power.
Your grip on that axe is shaking.
Hyphae have reached your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的每片落叶我都数着
lines.en: I count every leaf you crush underfoot.
My spores will get there first.

lines.zh: 这一片林子里没人帮你
lines.en: No one in this forest will help you.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在这林子里藏不住
lines.en: Your sweat has nowhere to hide in this forest.
You have nowhere left to go.
Take a blow from my stalk.
I fling a burst of spores.
Hyphae like vines wrap around you.
This mouthful will turn your stomach.
I slam down.
My cap hits your face.

lines.zh: 菌柄砸下去，你视线糊了
lines.en: My stalk comes down and your sight blurs.
My helpers are here.
Another one.
You retreat too slowly.
The dark forest soil loosened.
I rise out of the mushroom bed.
My cap pushes up through the leaves.
The spores arrive first, then me.
Who is trampling my ground?
Night falls, and out I come.
I hear footsteps.
A shape appears among the shadows.
I shake off the dirt.
Mycelium lifts me up.
This forest is lively again.
I am awake, do not come too close.
Soil after rain is the best.
I straighten up slowly.
Fire! Fire is what I fear most.
I fell from a height into mud.
Water floods my gills.
The blast flipped my cap.
An arrow sticks in my stalk.
That dark magic blackens my hyphae.
The rotting leaves ran out.
Lightning scorched my cap.
Even my spores cannot hold me.
